authority: Product Owner explicitly instructed SA to execute the proposed rule/core-logic updates; these rulings extend R1.0B FROZEN where prior SSOT was silent and do not supersede higher-authority filed/formally-approved documents.

decisions.subject: Return/Settlement Replay
decisions.ruling: Append-only reversal/clawback; do not overwrite historical Ledger or PAID. Reverse recognized volume/economic events and deterministically replay affected settlement and K0/K1/K2 downstream dependencies using historically effective snapshots. Re-derive carry from replayed effective volume; never reset it mechanically.

decisions.subject: EPV monthly threshold
decisions.ruling: Qualification + calendar month cumulative eligible personal consumption; max(0, consumption - NT$2000) * 60%. 4800 => 1680. Returns recompute that month's cumulative threshold; never subtract return amount * 60% mechanically.

decisions.subject: Settlement cut-off architecture
decisions.ruling: Use versioned period/cut-off/timezone/effective_from/effective_to configuration and settlement-time snapshots. No hardcoded weekday/time. Asia/Taipei is the approved timezone baseline; exact production cut-off values remain configuration pending until Product Owner approval.

decisions.subject: SSOT / legacy drift
decisions.ruling: Filed documents > formally approved company documents > R1.0/R1.0B system specifications > approved SA decisions > discussion/posters/legacy. Formal pools 42/36/15/5/2 and EPV 4800 => 1680. Conflicting legacy tests/fixtures are Legacy Test Drift; do not alter formal rules to satisfy them.

decisions.subject: Eligible Consumption Recognition
decisions.ruling: Eligibility is determined by a versioned ConsumptionRecognitionEvent, not by Order existence alone. Only paid/confirmed, non-gift, non-replacement, non-company-subsidy personal-consumption lines explicitly eligible under the effective rule may enter the monthly eligible-consumption accumulator. Gifts, free replacements, company compensation/subsidy and zero-consideration fulfillment do not generate eligible consumption. Points-only redemption does not create new eligible consumption; mixed points+cash recognizes only the authoritative eligible cash consideration unless a later formally approved rule explicitly provides otherwise. Tax, freight and payment fees are excluded unless a formally approved rule explicitly includes them. Return POSTED reverses the original recognition event in its historical recognition period and triggers replay.

decisions.subject: PV/BV/RPV/EPV Event Mapping
decisions.ruling: Order, payment, consumption recognition and volume recognition are separate domain events. OrderCreated creates no official PV/BV/RPV/EPV. PaymentConfirmed alone creates no volume. Sale/ConsumptionRecognition under the effective ProductProfile/RuleVersion emits immutable VolumeRecognition events scoped to Qualification, source line, recognition time/period and parameter snapshot. PV and BV remain independent fields/values even when configured equal; no hardcoded PV=BV equivalence. Existing GPV/RPV/EPV historical facts must not be renamed or migrated by inference. Return POSTED emits linked reversal events and replay; it never edits original recognition rows. Exact legacy GPV-to-PV/BV migration mapping remains fail-closed until evidence supports a deterministic mapping.

decisions.subject: Operational Calendar Model
decisions.ruling: All production schedules are represented by an immutable/versioned OperationalCalendarVersion containing timezone, period definition, recognition cut-off, settlement cut-off/schedule, effective window and approval reference. Asia/Taipei is the timezone baseline. No service may hardcode weekday/hour/month-end policy. Exact weekly/monthly production cut-off clock values remain Product Owner configuration pending; affected production posting stays fail-closed until approved.

decisions.subject: Binary inactive evidence
decisions.ruling: An ineligible/inactive Binary recipient must leave deterministic calculation evidence with zero entitlement and reason code; absence of an Award row alone is not sufficient audit evidence. Zero evidence is calculation/eligibility evidence and must not create a payable or monetary Ledger credit. Historical replay uses the historical Active snapshot.

decisions.subject: Matching/Equalization sponsor traversal
decisions.ruling: Matching/Equalization recipient traversal follows the historical Sponsor Tree of the earning period, never the Binary Tree and never current Sponsor state. Recipient identity is Qualification-scoped; another Qualification owned by the same Person cannot substitute. Historical Active/eligibility snapshots govern recipient eligibility. Existing formally specified skip/stop depth semantics remain authoritative; where a depth-specific skip/stop rule is absent, the engine must fail closed rather than invent compression.

decisions.subject: Carry lifecycle
decisions.ruling: Carry belongs to Qualification/Binary position, not Person. CarryOut = replayed effective CarryIn + eligible side volume - consumed/matched volume plus/minus linked historical adjustments according to the effective Binary rule. Suspend does not erase carry. Reactivation resumes the preserved/replayed carry. Transfer of Person ownership does not move carry to another Qualification. Permanent termination/expiry may clear carry only when an explicit effective RuleVersion authorizes it. Historical reversal must replay forward until carry converges; maxWeeks is a safety guard, not a business truncation rule.

decisions.subject: 45D lifecycle anchor
decisions.ruling: The holding period is anchored to the authoritative settlement period end/cut-off policy captured by the applicable OperationalCalendarVersion, not to when a delayed calculation job happens to finish. pendingUntil is persisted as historical evidence. Recalculation/replay must not move the original anchor merely because execution occurred later. During hold, adjustments are append-only entitlement deltas; after PAID, negative deltas become recovery/clawback/offset and never overwrite the original paid Award.

decisions.subject: Return state and economic recognition
decisions.ruling: Return workflow is REQUESTED -> APPROVED -> RECEIVED -> POSTED -> REFUNDED (or equivalent states preserving these semantics). REQUESTED/APPROVED/RECEIVED do not reverse official volume. POSTED is the authoritative economic/volume reversal event and triggers linked historical replay. REFUNDED records payment refund completion and may occur after POSTED; payment refund and volume reversal are separate idempotent events. Multiple returns are bounded by remaining reversible quantity/value and each return has a unique idempotency key.

pendingDecisions.subject: Exact production weekly/monthly recognition and settlement cut-off clock values
pendingDecisions.reason: Architecture/timezone are approved, but exact operational weekday/time/month-end values require Product Owner operational approval before production posting.

pendingDecisions.subject: Deterministic mapping of pre-existing GPV historical facts to formal PV/BV event fields
pendingDecisions.reason: New event semantics are approved prospectively. Existing GPV/RPV/EPV historical facts must not be reclassified without evidence and reconciliation.

pendingDecisions.subject: Any sponsor-depth-specific skip/stop/compression edge case not already stated in higher-authority R1.0B rules
pendingDecisions.reason: Sponsor Tree and historical eligibility are approved; unspecified compression/termination behavior remains fail-closed rather than inferred.
